items.name: read
items.source:
#[must_use]
pub fn read(path: &Path) -> Vec<Entry> {
    std::fs::read(path)
        .ok()
        .and_then(|bytes| serde_json::from_slice::<Document>(&bytes).ok())
        .map(|document| document.deployments)
        .unwrap_or_default()
}
